a: अभिकांक्ष् — {c1c} U. To ask, request; long for, wish or desire for.
अभिकांक्षा — Wish, desire, longing.
अभिकांक्षिन् — a. Longing, wishing.

m: अभि-√ काङ्क्ष् -काङ्क्षति, ˚ते, rarely Caus. -अयते, to long for, desire; to strive.

v: strI aBi + kANkza--BAve a । aBilApe “SItABikANkzA muKatiktatA ca” suSru॰ ।
m: अभि-काङ्क्षा f. longing for, desire (with acc. or ifc.)
अभि-काङ्क्षिन् mfn. longing for, desiring (with acc. [BhP.] or ifc. [Mn. iv, 91, &c.]).
अभि-काङ्क्षित mfn. longed for, wished, desired.
अभि-√ काश् Intens. -चाकशीति (1. sg. ˚शीमि; Imper. 2. sg. ˚शीथि; impf. 1. sg. -अचाकशम्) to illuminate, irradiate, VS.; to look on, to perceive, RV.; ŚBr. xiv.
अभि-काल m. N. of a village, R. ii, 68, 17.

v: tri॰ aBikAmayate aBi + kama--RiN--ac । 1 kAmayamAne “yAce tvAmaBikAmAhaM tasmAt kuru mama priyam” BA॰ A॰ pa॰ । mAve GaY । aBilAze pu॰ “manamApyaBikAmasya kurukzetraM yuDizWira! BA॰ ba॰ pa॰ aBikAmAdAgataH WaY ABikAmikaH aBilAzAt prApte tri॰ striyAM NIp । “guREScAnupamEryuktaH samastErABikAmikEH” BA॰ SA॰ pa॰ ।
m: अभि-काम m. (ifc. f(आ). ) affection, desire, N. BhP.
अभि-काम mf(आ)n., affectionate, loving, desirous (with acc. or ifc.)
a: अभिकाम — a. [कम्-अच् or अभिवृद्धः कामो यस्य] Affectionate, loving, desirous, wishing for, lustful, with the object of love in acc. or in comp.; याचे त्वामभिकामाहं Mb. --मः 1 Affection, love. --2 Wish, desire. --मं ind. Longingly, with desire.

m: अभि-कामम् ind. with desire, L., (cf. आभिकामिक.)

a: अभिकामिक — a. Voluntary.

m: अभि-√ 1. कॄ -किरति, to pour over, throw over, cover.
अभि-√ कूज् to twitter, warble, R.

s: tri, (aBikAmayate iti anukABiketi sADuH .) kAmI । kAmukaH । ityamaraH ॥
v: tri॰ aBikAmayate aBi + kan । 1 anukABikABIkAH kamiteti” pA॰ ni॰ । kAmuke ‘so'DikAramaBikaH kulocitaM kAScana svayamavarttayat samAH” raGuH ।
m: अभिक mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 74) lustful, libidinous, Ragh. xix, 4 (cf. 1. अभीक and अनुक)
अभिक m. a lover, Naiṣ.
a: अभि(भी)क — a. [अभि-कन् निपातोयं; P. V. 2. 74] {1} Lustful, libidinous, voluptuous; सोधिकारमभिकः कुलोचितं काश्चन स्वयमवर्तयत्समाः R. 19. 4; अपि सिंचेः कृशानौ त्वं दर्पं मय्यपि योऽभिकः Bk. 8. 92. --कः A lover, voluptuous person.

k.v: कम्रः कामयिताभीकः कमनः कामनोऽभिकः। विधेयो विनयग्राही वचनेस्थित आश्रवः॥

a: अभिकंप् — {c1c} A. To shake or tremble violently. --Caus. 1 To stir, shake. --2 To allure, entice.
अभिकंपनं — Shaking; alluring.

m: अभि-√ कम् (fut. -कमिष्यते) to desire, love, TBr. : Caus. -कामयते id., MBh.; BhP.
a: अभिकम् — {c10c} A. To love, desire; कः स्त्रियमभिकामयमानां नाभिनंदति Dk. 88; Ki. 18. 23.

m: अभि-√ कम्प् -कम्पते, to tremble vehemently, MBh. iii, 15721 : Caus. -कम्पयति, to stir, allure, KātyŚr.
अभि-कर्ण-कूपम् ind. into the auditory passage, Naiṣ.
अभि-कर m. a performer, executor, GopBr.
अभि-करण See स्वप्नाभिकरण.
a: अभिकरणं — 1 Effecting, doing. --2 A charm, incantation.

m: अभि-कर्मन् mfn. performing bringing about, Dharmaś.
अभि-√ 1. कृ to do with reference to or in behalf of ŚBr.; (perf. 2. pl. -चक्र) to procure, effect, AV. iii, 9, 1; (with निवेशं) to settle.
a: अभिकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To make, render, do; कुरुक्षेत्रे निवेशमभिचक्रतुः Mb. --2 To do with reference to, for the sake of, or in behalf of. --3 To procure, get, obtain, effect.

m: अभि-कृति f. N. of a metre (containing one hundred syllables), RPrāt. &c.
a: अभिकृतिः — f. N. of a metre containing 100 syllables.

a: अभिकृत्वन् — a. (m. ˚त्वा; f. ˚त्वरी) Magieal; a magician or spirit.

m: अभि-कृत्वरी f. ‘producing (diseases)’, a female demon, AV. ii, 8, 2.
अभि-√ कृष् -कर्षति, to overpower, MBh. iii, 15064.
अभि-कृष्णम् ind. towards Kṛṣṇa, Śiś.
अभि-क्नूयम् ind. (√ क्नूय्), so as to bemoisten, ŚBr. xiv.

a: अभिक्रांतिन् — a. [इष्टादिगण] 1 One who has approached or undertaken or begun. --2 Skilled or versed in, conversant with (with loc.).

v: avya॰ aBi + krasa--vIpsABIkzRyayoH Ramul । Akramya, AraBya, ABimuKyena gatvetyarTe । pUrvvaM pUrvvamevABikrAmam” kAtyA॰ 3, 2, 21 ।
m: अभि-क्रामम् ind. so as to step near, MaitrS.; KātyŚr.
अभि-क्रान्त mfn. approached
attacked
begun
अभि-क्रान्त n. = अभि-क्रान्ति, PBr.

v: strI aBi + krama--ktin । 1 aBikrame 2 upakrame “yajYasyABikrAntiranapakramAya” SrutiH ।
m: अभि-क्रान्ति f. Ved. overpowering, bringing into one's possession, TS.; AitBr. &c.

v: tri॰ aBikrAntamanena izwAdi॰ ini । upakramakarttari “ya ezAmaDyayane aBikrAntitamaH” SrutiH ।
m: अभि-क्रान्तिन् mfn. one who has undertaken (the study of) i.e. conversant with (loc.), Lāṭy.
अभि-√ क्री to buy for a special purpose, ŚBr.

a: अभिक्रंद् — {c1c} P. To shout at, roar at; neigh at.
अभिक्रंदः — A shout, roar.

m: अभि-√ क्रम् (aor. -अक्रमीत् ind.p. -क्रम्य) to step or go near to, approach, RV. &c.; to attack, overpower, RV. vi, 49, 15 & ix, 40, 1; to step upon; to undertake, begin, RPrāt.; (with गमनाय) to get on one's way, R. i, 77, 18 : Caus. -क्रमयति, to bring near, TS.
a: अभिक्रम् — {c1c} U., {c4c} P. 1 To step or go near to, approach; तमभिक्रम्य सर्वेऽद्य वयं चार्थामहे वसु Mb. --2 To roam over, wander, pass or walk over. --3 To attack, assail, fall upon. --4 To undertake, begin; to set about, prepare; गमनायाभिचक्राम Rām. --Caus. To bring near.

s: puM, (aBi + krama + GaY । nodAtteti vfdDyaBAvaH । aBikramyate karmmaRA prAraByate iti vyutpattyA karmmArabDaPale prAramBe ca .) aBItayoDAderyudDe SatrusammuKagamanaM । ArohaRaM । iti hemacandraH ॥

m: अभि-क्रम m. stepping near, approaching
assault, attack, L.
overpowering, PBr.; Gaut.
ascending
undertaking, attempt, beginning.
a: अभिक्रमः — 1 Beginning, attempting, an undertaking; नेहाभिक्रमनाशोस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते Bg. 2. 40. --2 A determined attack or onset, assault, onslaught. --3 Ascending, mounting.

k.v: स्यादासारः प्रसरणं प्रचक्रं चलितार्थकम्. अहितान्प्रत्यभीतस्य रणे यानमभिक्रमः॥

m: अभि-क्रमण n. stepping near, approaching, Gaut. &c.
a: अभिक्रमणं, --क्रांतिः — f. Approaching, attacking &c. = अभिक्रम above; पुंड्रदेश˚ Dk. 92.

m: अभि-क्रम—नाश m. unsuccessful effort, Bhag.
अभि-√ क्रन्द् (aor. 2. sg. -क्रन्) to shout at, roar at, neigh or whinny at, RV.; AV.; Lāṭy. : Caus. (aor. -अचिक्रदत्), id., RV. ix, 68, 2 and 82, 1 : Intens. (p. -कनिक्रदत्) id., RV.
अभि-क्रन्द m. a shout, MBh.

m: अभि-क्रतु mfn. insolent, haughty, RV. iii, 34, 10.
a: अभिक्रतु — a. [अभिमुख्येन क्रतुर्युद्धकर्म यस्य] Haughty, very powerful ( बलीयस्) (as an enemy), Rv. 3. 34. 10.

v: pu॰ aBi + kruSa--BAve GaY । 1 AkroSe 2 nindAyAm ।
a: अभिक्रोशः — 1 Calling out, crying. --2 Reviling, censure.

m: अभि-क्रोशक m. a reviler (निन्दक), VS.
a: अभिक्रोशकः — 1 One who calls out; a reviler, calumniator. --2 A herald.

m: अभि-√ क्रुध् to be angry with (acc.), Pāṇ. i, 4, 38, Sch.; Vikr.
अभि-√ क्रुश् to cry out at, call out to, to call to (in a scolding manner), AV. &c.; to lament with tears, bemoan, R. iv, 24, 22.
a: अभिक्रुश् — {c1c} P. 1 To cry out at, call out to. --2 To call out (to one) in a scolding manner; अन्योन्यमभिचक्रुशुः Mb. --3 To weep over, lament with tears, bemoan.

m: अभि-क्रुद्ध mfn. being angry, MBh.; BhP.
अभि-√ कुत्स् to revile, inveigh against, R. ii, 75, 2.
अभि-√ कुष् -कुष्णाति, to tear, pull at, pinch, Suśr.
अभि-√ कॢप् Ā. (p. -कल्पमान) to be adequate to, be in accordance with (acc.), VS. xiii, 25 : Caus. -कल्पयति, to put in order, R.

अ-भिक्ष-दा mfn. [Padap. अभि-क्ष-दा] giving without being asked, RV. vi, 50, 1
[according to the Padap. (cf. अभि-क्षत्तृ) ‘destroying, a destroyer’, Sāy.]

v: tri॰ aBi + kzada--hiMsAyAm ac । hiMsake । “aBikzadAmaryyamARam” f॰ 6, 50, 1 । aBikzadAM hiMsakaM CAndasatvAt Attvam ।
a: अभिक्षद — a. [क्षद्-अच्] Ved. A destroyer; Rv. 6. 50. 1.; giving without being asked (?).

m: अभि-√ क्षम् (Opt. -क्षमेत; Imper. 2. pl. -क्षमध्वम्) to be gracious, propitious to (dat. or loc.), RV.; to pardon (perf. Opt. 2. sg. -चक्षमीथाः), RV. ii, 33, 7.
अभि-√ क्षर् (aor. 3. sg. -अक्षह्, RV. ix, 97, 45) to flow near or round, RV.; ŚBr.; to pour on AV.

v: tri॰ aBi + kzada--tfc striyAM NIp । hiMsake “aBikzattustvAvato varUtAH” f॰ 7 । 21 । 8 । “aBikzatturaBihiMsakasya” BA॰ ।
m: अभि-क्षत्तृ ता, m. (√ क्षद्), ‘one who carves and distributes (food)’ an host, RV. ii, 29, 2 and vii, 21, 8
[‘a destroyer’, Sāy.]
a: अभिक्षत्तृ — a. Ved. A murderer, killer, destroyer.

m: अभि-क्षेप m. a partic. manner of handling a club, Nīlak.
अभि-√ क्षिप् (only P. Pāṇ. i, 3, 80; pr. p. -क्षिपत्) to fling at (as the lash of a whip at a horse), RV. v, 83, 3; to excel, Bhaṭṭ.
a: अभिक्षिप् — {c6c} P. 1 To throw or fling at (as the lash of a whip at a horse); to insult. --2 To excel; Bk. 8. 51.
अभिक्षिप्त — p. p. Thrown, surpassed.

m: अ-भिक्षित mfn. not asked for alms, ŚBr.
